meta.name: VoltBridge Mobility sample data

personas.story: Service Manager, Pune. Rates his whole team ~4.6/5 → leniency flag → calibration; his 'leaders built' score is low too.
Line Lead, Pune. Output on target but a safety near-miss → absolute standards + team gainsharing, never ranking. Person-level TNA → HV-safety refresher; skill-based pay L2 → L3.

Battery R&D, Shenzhen. Hit 0.7 on stretch OKRs (good in OKR terms); forced ranking would have punished the ambition; patent bonus. Built-70 persona: first-time team lead with a tech-transfer rotation to Pune; helix and passport fill over the year.
Sales Consultant, Bengaluru. Top 5% on the leaderboard → bonus tier 1, Club trip, 9-box Star → development toward sales manager.
Sales Consultant, Delhi. #2 on units but fails the fair-selling gate (fake test-drive bookings) → rating capped, no top-tier bonus. How matters as much as what.
Sales Consultant, Chengdu. Bottom 10% of the China pool. Country lens: in China a low rank alone is not a lawful dismissal ground → training/reassignment. In India the same data → documented PIP.
Customer Support, Shenzhen. Her pool has 8 people → the ranking engine refuses forced distribution ('pool too small to rank fairly').

meta.note: All names, numbers and people are fictional. Pay and budget figures are placeholders.

Org.vision: Make clean mobility the obvious choice for Asia's next billion commuters.
Org.mission: Design, build and service affordable, safe EVs and charging. Engineered in Shenzhen and Bengaluru, built in Pune and Changsha, supported wherever our customers drive.

Roles.title: Assembly Line Technician
Roles.purpose: Assemble EV sub-systems to standard work, safely and right first time.
Roles.responsibilities: Run assigned stations to standard work;Lock-out/tag-out before any high-voltage task;Report near misses and defects at once;Join daily huddles and kaizen
Roles.knowledge: Standard work for assigned stations;High-voltage safety basics;Quality standards
Roles.skills: Torque and fixture use;Basic diagnostics;Reading work instructions
Roles.abilities: Manual dexterity;Attention to detail;Stamina for shift work
Roles.other: ITI or diploma;HV-safety certification (or within 3 months)

Roles.title: Quality Inspector
Roles.purpose: Stop defects from leaving the line and find their root cause.
Roles.responsibilities: Inspect to control plan;Run audits;Write root-cause reports;Release or hold batches
Roles.abilities: Judgement under time pressure;Attention to detail

Roles.title: Battery Cell R&D Engineer
Roles.purpose: Develop the next-generation cell and get it pilot-ready.
Roles.responsibilities: Design and run cell experiments;Analyse cycle-life data;Transfer technology to plants;Co-author papers and patents with Bengaluru
Roles.abilities: Creative problem solving;Persistence through failed experiments
Roles.other: Master's or PhD in chemistry, materials or electrical engineering

Roles.title: Vehicle Software Engineer
Roles.purpose: Ship safe, reliable over-the-air software for VoltBridge vehicles.
Roles.responsibilities: Build and test vehicle software;Ship OTA releases;Fix security vulnerabilities;Review peers' code
Roles.skills: C/C++ and Python;Testing and CI;Code review

Roles.title: EV Sales Consultant
Roles.purpose: Turn test drives into happy owners, fairly.
Roles.responsibilities: Run test drives;Advise on models, finance and insurance;Close bookings;Keep the CRM accurate;Follow fair-selling rules
Roles.knowledge: VoltBridge models and charging;Finance and insurance products;Fair-selling rules

Roles.title: Customer Support Associate
Roles.purpose: Solve owners' problems on the first contact.
Roles.responsibilities: Answer calls and chats;Resolve or route issues;Log every case;Escalate safety issues

Roles.title: Charging Field Technician
Roles.purpose: Keep every charger in the territory up and safe.
Roles.responsibilities: Preventive maintenance;Repair chargers;Follow HV safety;Update tickets

Roles.title: Supply Chain Manager
Roles.purpose: Secure parts on time, at cost, from more than one source.
Roles.responsibilities: Manage suppliers;Plan inventory;Negotiate costs;Build dual sourcing

Roles.title: People Manager
Roles.purpose: Hit the team's goals and build the next leaders.
Roles.responsibilities: Set and review team goals;Coach every report;Run calibration;Keep the team safe;Build successors
Roles.knowledge: The team's domain;PMS process;Labour rules for the country
Roles.other: 5+ years in the domain; first-time manager programme
Roles.job_analysis_method: Structured interviews + 360 review of the role

Roles.title: Leadership Team
Roles.purpose: Set strategy and own the company's results.

KPIs.kpi_name: Safety index (incidents down, near-miss reports up)
KR: cycle life at or above target
KR: OTA crash-free rate at or above 99.5%
KR: critical vulnerabilities closed within SLA
Fair-selling compliance (no fake bookings, no undisclosed discounts)
Leaders built (IDPs done, internal promotions, mentoring hours)

Competencies.name: Teamwork
Competencies.description: Helps the team win, not just themselves.

Competencies.name: Customer focus
Competencies.description: Sees every task through the customer's eyes.

Competencies.name: Learning agility
Competencies.bars_5: Learns faster than the role changes

Competencies.name: Leading others
Competencies.description: Gets results through people and grows them.

Competencies.name: Cross-cultural collaboration
Competencies.description: Works well across India and China.
